defaultPrompt: /thox-research-paper Research my topic with recent primary papers, an engineering loop and independent validation.
/thox-research-paper Review the current manuscript, reproduce supported results and fix evidence gaps.
/thox-research-paper Prepare a THOX paper and a separate arXiv-ready source package for review.
interface.longDescription: Run /thox-research-paper for a requested topic. Coordinates research, methodology, engineering, manuscript integration and independent review. Builds a topic-specific primary-paper context from the previous 6 to 12 months, applies existing THOX research and document standards, records reproducible evidence and prepares scholarly exports. Requires the existing THOX skills and available research/execution capabilities. Runs during the conversation; no background service, model training or automatic publication.

name: thox-research-paper
description: Coordinate THOX research teams, recent literature, engineering experiments and independent paper validation using existing THOX skills.
